purpose: Summarise an application against the published requirements for the Senior Backend Engineer role, to prepare a human hiring decision.
input_summary: One CV and cover letter (candidate reference APP-2026-0412), plus the published job requirements. No demographic data supplied.
output_summary: A structured summary of relevant experience with three requirement gaps noted, and a recommendation to proceed to a first interview.

data_recipients.transfer_mechanism: SCCs (Commission Implementing Decision 2021/914) under the Anthropic Commercial DPA
data_recipients.retention: Not retained for training; API inputs and outputs handled under the commercial terms

reasoning_summary: Each published requirement was checked against statements in the CV. Six of nine requirements are evidenced by named projects with dates. Three are not mentioned at all: Kubernetes operations, on-call experience, and formal mentoring. The recommendation to interview rests on the six evidenced requirements and on eight years of relevant backend experience; it does not rest on any assessment of the candidate as a person.

sources.relevance: The only evidence about the candidate

confidence.rationale: Requirement matching from a CV is reliable for what is written and blind to what is not. Absence of a skill in a CV is not evidence of its absence in the candidate.

limitations: Only assesses what the candidate chose to write down. Unstated experience is invisible to this process.
Cannot assess communication, collaboration, or judgement — an interview does that.
Career gaps were not interpreted, since interpretation risks indirect discrimination.
Self-reported seniority in a CV was taken at face value and not verified.

human_review.reason: Recruitment screening is an Annex III high-risk use case and produces effects on individuals. No candidate is advanced or rejected on this output alone.
human_review.decision_notes: Agreed on advancing to interview. Removed the model's inference about 'likely culture fit', which was unsupported by the source material. Added a note to probe Kubernetes experience directly rather than treating its absence as disqualifying.

disclosure.disclosure_text: We use an AI assistant to summarise applications against the published role requirements. Every decision is made by a member of our hiring team. You can ask us how AI was used in your application at any time.
